chars.DJ: THE DJ: a tall Moroccan man about 30, short black hair, trimmed beard, black cap worn backwards, oversized white t-shirt with one red horizontal stripe, silver chain, black jeans, white sneakers
chars.GIRL: THE GIRL: a Swedish woman in her late 20s, long straight platinum-blonde hair, light blue eyes, mint-green satin top, white wide-leg trousers, gold hoop earrings
chars.MUSTACHE: MUSTACHE GUY: a slim Moroccan man about 30 with a thick black mustache and wavy black hair, unbuttoned silk shirt with a loud orange-and-purple pattern, wide beige trousers, sunglasses pushed up on his head
chars.BOUNCERS: BOUNCERS: two huge bald bouncers in black suits over black t-shirts, earpieces

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a crowded Casablanca nightclub with purple and blue lights: THE DJ leaps over his DJ booth mid-air, arms spread, furious determined face, turntables and headphones flying behind him, dancers below looking up shocked. Comic action shot.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: On the nightclub dance floor THE DJ has landed on MUSTACHE GUY and both crash to the floor in a tangled heap, MUSTACHE GUY's sunglasses flying, people around stepping back gasping. Comic, not bloody.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Two BOUNCERS lift THE DJ off the floor by his arms, his feet dangling, his backwards cap falling off, embarrassed panicked face, club lights behind. Comic, no blood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Outside the nightclub at night on a Casablanca street, THE GIRL shrugs with a dreamy smile, hands open, explaining; THE DJ stands in front of her with a messy t-shirt and a small bruise, mouth open in disbelief.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: THE DJ sits alone at night on the edge of his bed in a small Casablanca apartment, holding his phone with an Instagram-style chat open (no readable text), face palming in regret.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Split-screen style video call: on the left THE GIRL in a cosy Swedish apartment laughing casually, on the right THE DJ in Casablanca grinning with hearts in his eyes, holding the phone close. Warm light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: THE DJ alone behind his DJ booth in the emptying club at closing time, headphones around his neck, staring sadly at the dance floor, one disco ball light on him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Daytime on a sunny Casablanca street with white buildings and palm trees: THE GIRL walks laughing arm in arm with MUSTACHE GUY, who struts proudly with a big smile, passers-by turning to look.
